about.heading: Hi, I'm Sina.
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer living in Antalya, Türkiye.
about.p2: I write backend systems in Python and Django and build interfaces with React and Next.js. I also set up and manage Google Ads campaigns and the tracking behind them.
about.p3: Doing both means I build websites with marketing in mind from day one, and I run campaigns knowing exactly how the site works.
about.p4: I work with clients in English, Turkish, Persian and Russian, and I keep communication simple: clear plans, regular updates, no jargon.
focus: Interfaces that feel premium and load fast
Measurement you can trust before you spend more
Honest communication about scope and progress

sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.text: This website is operated by Sina Jokar, Antalya, Türkiye. For any privacy question, email cnajokar11@yahoo.com.

sections.title: What is collected
sections.text: When you send the project inquiry form, the details you enter are stored: name, email, requested service, optional budget range, project description and your consent. The site language and submission time are recorded too.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: Only to reply to your inquiry and discuss your project. Your details are not sold or shared for advertising.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.text: Inquiries are stored in the website's database and a notification email is sent to Sina Jokar's inbox. Access to stored inquiries is limited to the site owner.

sections.title: How long
sections.text: Inquiries are kept for up to 24 months and then deleted, unless they become part of an ongoing project.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: If analytics is enabled, it only runs after you allow it in the cookie notice. Form contents are never sent to analytics tools.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information you sent by emailing cnajokar11@yahoo.com.
